narrative.overview:
FloorTest looks like the inside of a DJ booth late in a set: near-black, warm, quiet, with one light that matters. Everything is ink and bone; a single lime accent marks the thing to do next, the way a cue light does on a deck. Nothing glows for decoration. The interface is a working surface for people deciding quickly, often on a phone between gigs, so it is dense, technical and calm rather than expressive.

The whole product is set in one monospaced face, which gives every screen the feel of gear: counts line up, durations and BPM read like readouts, labels read like panel markings. Depth is quiet. Surfaces step up in tone, not in shadow, and only things that float (menus, dialogs, toasts) cast one. Day theme is the same booth with the lights on: warm off-white paper, olive where lime would be unreadable as text, lime fills kept for the main action.
keyCharacteristics: One accent, Cue Lime, reserved for the main action, live states and counts that need attention.
One typeface, JetBrains Mono, everywhere; Instrument Serif italic only as a home-page accent.
Tonal layering for depth; shadows only on floating things.
Four corner radii by role, nothing in between.
Dense, scannable rows; decision-time actions always visible.
Night is the default; the navigation stays dark in both themes.

rules.name: The One Light Rule
rules.body: Cue Lime appears where the next action or a live signal is, and nowhere else. If two lime buttons compete in one area, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Bone Not White Rule
rules.body: Never hard-code white in the app. Bone is the theme's ink and flips by day; only things drawn over artwork or a QR code stay white.

rules.name: The Token Only Rule
rules.body: Every colour comes from a token so both themes work. A hard-coded hex is a Day-theme bug waiting to happen.

rules.name: The One Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Section titles use the 11px bold spaced-caps eyebrow in Mute. No other eyebrow style exists.

rules.name: The Size Brings Its Leading Rule
rules.body: Each type role carries its own line-height; never set a size without it.

rules.name: The Floaters Only Rule
rules.body: Page cards have borders, not shadows. If it doesn't float above the page, it doesn't cast a shadow.

rules.name: The No Nesting Rule
rules.body: A card never holds another card.

dos: Do use Cue Lime for the one main action per area and for live signals only.
Do take every colour from a token so Night and Day both work.
Do use the four radii by role (8 / 12 / 16 / 22px) and pills for chips.
Do keep text at 4.5:1 or better against its actual surface in both themes (WCAG 2.2 AA).
Do keep touch targets at 44px on touch screens.
Do animate only transform and opacity: entering 150–250ms ease-out from opacity 0 and scale 0.97; reduced motion keeps fades and drops movement.
donts: Don't hard-code white or any hex in components.
Don't add shadows to page cards or nest a card inside a card.
Don't introduce a second typeface outside the home-page serif accent.
Don't add a second accent colour or a gradient for decoration.
Don't repeat on the page what it already says (no status chip matching the selected tab, no stat shown twice).
Don't animate keyboard-driven actions (K, X, U, Space) or start anything from scale 0.
